N.promptText: [S1] At two forty-seven in the morning, a number he didn't know sent him a text. Jay was playing The Endless Halls. The game where the tall man only moves when you look away.

lines.text: Jay has lived this exact night forty-seven times.
lines.cap: Jay has lived this *exact night* forty-seven times.

lines.text: Every time he misses the last jump in Rooftop Rush, the clock goes back to nine. And nobody else remembers.
lines.cap: Every time he misses the last jump in *Rooftop Rush,* the clock goes back to *9:00.* And nobody else remembers.
lines.dia: Every time he misses the last jump in Rooftop Rush, the clock goes back to nine. And nobody else remembers. Nobody.

lines.text: Loop one, he thought it was a glitch.
lines.cap: Loop one, he thought it was a *glitch.*
lines.dia: Loop one, he thought it was a glitch. Just a glitch.

lines.text: Loop twelve, he tried every route on the map.
lines.cap: Loop twelve, he tried *every route* on the map.
lines.dia: Loop twelve, he tried every route on the map. Every one.

lines.text: Loop thirty, he tried to stop playing. The game turned itself back on.
lines.cap: Loop thirty, he tried to *stop playing.* The game turned itself *back on.*
lines.dia: Loop thirty, he tried to stop playing. The game turned itself back on. By itself.

lines.text: What would you try? Comment it.
lines.dia: What would you try? Comment it. Go on.

lines.text: Loop forty-six, he saw something new. Another player, on the very last roof.
lines.cap: Loop forty-six, he saw something *new.* Another player, on the very *last roof.*
lines.dia: Loop forty-six, he saw something new. Another player, on the very last roof. Waiting.

lines.text: It was Maya. She'd been stuck in the same night... every single time.
lines.cap: It was *Maya.* She'd been stuck in the same night... *every single time.*
lines.dia: It was Maya. She'd been stuck in the same night... every single time. Just like him.

lines.text: They had one idea left. Jump at the exact same time.
lines.cap: They had one idea left. Jump at the *exact same time.*
lines.dia: They had one idea left. Jump at the exact same time. Together.

lines.text: Did they make it? Comment it.
lines.dia: Did they make it? Comment it. Tell me.

lines.text: Rooftop Rush is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.cap: *Rooftop Rush* is one of *tons* of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports.
lines.dia: Rooftop Rush is one of tons of free games on Pulsebox. Racing, heists, horror, sports. And more.

lines.text: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer... if you can stop.
lines.cap: Free at... *box.pulseform.org.* Play it on a *computer...* if you can stop.
lines.dia: Free at box dot pulseform dot org. Play it on a computer... if you can stop. Good luck.
